name: Night Owls
character: Ink and rose after hours: a guild for people who get off work at 8 and sew when the rest of the town has gone to bed.

sections.title: {{guild_name}}
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: {{guild_name}} meets {{meeting_info}}, which is later than other guilds on purpose. If you work a restaurant, a hospital, or a closing shift, this is the room.

sections.heading: When we sew
sections.note: Doors at 8:30 p.m. Sewing until 11. The building wants us out at 11:15. Coffee is decaf after 10.

items.title: Late sew
items.body: No morning bees. No lunch sit-and-sew. If you are free at 10 a.m. this is not your guild.

items.title: Quiet hour
items.body: 10 to 11 is machines only, talk down. Some of us came from a loud job.

items.title: Transit
items.body: We end in time for the last reliable train. If you drive, the lot is lit.

sections.title: Join {{guild_name}}
sections.body: Dues are collected once a year.

sections.title: About {{guild_name}}
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: A guild that refuses to meet when night workers are still on the floor.

sections.heading: How we started
sections.html: Sample text — replace me: Daytime guilds are not hostile. They are timed for people who are free at 6. {{guild_name}} is timed for the rest of {{city}}. We still have show and tell. We still have dues. We do not apologize for starting when the dinner shift ends.

items.title: Winter
items.body: Same hours. Dress for the wait at the bus.

items.title: Summer
items.body: Still 8:30. Daylight is not our clock.

items.title: One Saturday
items.body: October, for the people who want a daylight sew once a year. Optional.

sections.title: How Late
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: The clock, the building, and how we keep the last hour quiet.

sections.heading: The last hour
sections.html: Sample text — replace me: From 10 p.m. we sew. Announcements already happened. If you arrive at 10:05 you sit down and stitch. Questions go to a note on the design wall, not a room-wide pause.

sections.heading: The night
sections.note: Buzzer code in the newsletter. Do not hold the street door open.

sections.title: Membership
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Dues cover a room that other groups do not want at that hour, which is why we can afford it.

items.q: I work days. May I join anyway?
items.a: If you will come at 8:30 p.m., yes. If you want a 6 p.m. guild, there are several.

items.q: Is it safe to leave at 11?
items.a: We walk out together. The lot is shared with the clinic next door. Nobody waits alone by a car.
